The presence of multiple agents targeting the same pathway strengthens the hypothesis that the compound may exert its effects through a common mechanism, potentially involving the inhibition of these kinases. The evidence is supported by a consistent pattern of target engagement, though the exact mode of action remains to be fully elucidated. The compound's role in the Raji cell line is further supported by the presence of a well-documented target, suggesting a plausible biological interaction.
